## Proposed Changes

### Fix Image Brightness/Contrast during PDF/Print
- **Issue:** The CSS filter is applied natively on screen, but when exporting, `applyFiltersToImage` re-encodes the image with the filter baked in. Since the cloned element still has the CSS filter, it gets applied *twice*.
- **Fix:** In `utils/reportGenerator.ts`, inside `inlineBlobImages`, we will explicitly remove `img.style.filter = "none"` after baking the filter into the base64 data.

### Fix Image Quality during PDF Export
- **Issue:** The `html2canvas` scale was reduced to 2, and the JPEG compression was set to `0.90` (90%), degrading the medical images.
- **Fix:** In `utils/reportGenerator.ts`, I will increase the scale back to `3` and increase the JPEG compression quality to `0.98` (98%).

- **Issue:** The "STANDALONE LINE", "STOMACH" etc. labels use `THEME.muted` (#64748b).

- **Issue:** The "DILATATION" heading has a red border, red text, and an arrow `▶` in `ReportPreview.tsx`.
- **Fix:** I will change the color and border to `#000` (black) and remove the `<span>` that renders the `▶` icon.

### Category Name Cascade to Templates
- **Issue:** Updating a category name (e.g. "sigmoidoscopy" -> "sigmoidoscopy report") leaves existing templates pointing to the old name.
- **Fix:** In `categoryRepo.js`, I will update the `updateCategory` function to fetch the old category name first. If the name has changed, it will run an `UPDATE templates SET category = ? WHERE category = ?` query to cascade the change.

### Save as Word Feature
- **Issue:** Replace "Image" button with "Save as Word" and save it using the same path logic as PDFs.
- **Fix:**
    - In `ReportForm.tsx`, replace the "Image" button with "Save as Word".
